no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and answers, and keeps only its own task rows (calendar-task) in your own store. Its records come in as input.records (ai, calendar-task, sample-consumer) and its writes go back as keep.
instructions: Say to your AI: "Finish this task after checking its consumer", and give it as, id, taken_at (the claim you hold), result and check (the consumer you read).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:finish-a-task and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Reads the consumer the saved acceptance names, applies its checks and finishes the task only if they all pass.
